**Stable ID:** `DATA-02.04` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 02 Dataset discovery and source inventory

Inventory commercial, licensed and vendor-hosted datasets, recording access and terms without purchasing or redistributing them.

## Deliverables

- Inventory of commercial dataset publishers and marketplaces
- Candidate list with public product pages

## Canonical artifact paths

- `research/sources/commercial.md`
- `catalog/proposals/`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Only publicly visible product metadata, cited with access date

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No paid access, account creation or non-public terms are used
- [ ] Price is recorded only if publicly stated, with date
- [ ] Candidates are proposals only

## Non-goals

- Purchasing datasets
- Vendor outreach or endorsements

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-02.04.T1` Inventory vendors
  - [ ] `DATA-02.04.T1.S1` List dataset marketplaces
  - [ ] `DATA-02.04.T1.S2` List vendor-published datasets
- [ ] `DATA-02.04.T2` Collect candidates
  - [ ] `DATA-02.04.T2.S1` Record publicly stated access model
  - [ ] `DATA-02.04.T2.S2` Record publicly stated terms URL
  - [ ] `DATA-02.04.T2.S3` Mark unknown commercial terms explicitly

## Dependencies

- Blocked by `DATA-02.01` Discovery method and source-use policy
- Blocked by `DATA-04.01` Dataset identifier and publisher model

## Review requirements

- Rights reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.

## Cross-repository handoffs

- None.
